headline: Aliens might leave a digital footprint
standfirst: Advanced civilizations could create specific energy signals with their computers.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Scientists suggest advanced alien civilizations might emit unique signals from their computers.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Earth's AI boom is straining our power grids and chip makers, sparking new theories on energy use.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: This gives us a new way to look for life beyond Earth by hunting for specific energy signatures.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: We will see if astronomers can identify these specific energy patterns in deep space data.

caption:
Scientists are searching for alien life by looking for the energy signals of hyper efficient computers.

AI requires massive amounts of power to run, which creates a noticeable energy footprint. Researchers think alien societies might use similar technology, leaving a detectable trail for us to find.

Do you think we will ever find evidence of advanced life in the universe?
